title: Seoul Metropolitan Ballet pays tribute to Hans van Manen, adds 2 int'l dancers
caption:
The Seoul Metropolitan Ballet honors Hans van Manen with a new triple-bill program. Two international dancers join the cast to mark the late choreographer's legacy.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul Metropolitan Ballet pays tribute to Hans van Manen, adds 2 int'l dancers
